name: py-probe
description: Today's collectors, discovery, docker and kubernetes listings (secmonk package)

collectors.name: docker-engine
collectors.description: Live container (or local image) via a local or remote Docker/Podman engine

collectors.name: docker-image
collectors.description: Container image: registry reference, docker-save tarball or OCI layout dir (no daemon)

collectors.name: fs
collectors.description: Language dependencies in a folder/repo: lockfiles, manifests, installed packages, binaries

collectors.name: git
collectors.description: Git repository (https, ssh, local): project kinds + lockfiles/manifests of every ecosystem

collectors.name: homebrew
collectors.description: Homebrew/Linuxbrew formulae (active kegs), casks and vendored language dependencies

collectors.name: k8s
collectors.description: Kubernetes cluster via kubectl: control plane, kubelet/runtime/OS per node, images in use

collectors.name: macos
collectors.description: macOS apps (.app bundles), Homebrew formulae/casks, pkgutil receipts and OS version

collectors.name: process
collectors.description: Running processes: launch origin (service/agent/app/shell...), software identity + version, provenance

collectors.name: rootfs
collectors.description: Linux root filesystem directory (dpkg/apk/rpm + python/npm packages)

collectors.name: sbom
collectors.description: Import a CycloneDX (1.4-1.6) or SPDX 2.x JSON bill of materials

collectors.name: ssh
collectors.description: Remote Linux/macOS host over SSH (agentless, read-only): `secmonk scan ssh user@host[:port]`

collectors.name: windows
collectors.description: Windows host: JSON from the PowerShell script (`secmonk windows-script`) (target), osquery results (-o osquery=<file>) or live on Windows
